ProcessingRouteSurfaceTests.test_process.note: The route still mounts Files for Processing in the main tile, now as the managed upload queue (§11.5). The path-based inbox page this test opened was the SQLite Library's and is never shown on PostgreSQL.

ProcessingRouteSurfaceTests.test_save_an.note: Saving a file's draft metadata and importing it into the Library is checked on the upload queue. The inbox directory, PATCH /api/processing-files/<name> and its import route belong to the retired path-based inbox, which the SQLite deletion PR removes with this module.
